children: Braveheart Bio, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results showing no product revenue and a widened net loss as the company ramped late-stage development and trial activities tied to its lead candidate.
Revenue: $0 for Q2 2026 and the six months ended June 30, 2026 (no product sales reported).
Net income: Net loss attributable to common stockholders of $(18.6M) for Q2 2026, versus $(0.38M) in the year-ago quarter (widening loss).
Diluted EPS: $(2.51) for Q2 2026, compared with $(0.14) in the year-ago quarter.
Product development: Advanced BHB-1893 into global Phase 3—LIONHEART-HCM has started and NOBLEHEART-HCM is planned for H1 2027—targeting both oHCM and nHCM populations.
Clinical operations: Significant Phase 3 start-up spending and site activation activity to support rapid trial progression and manufacturing scale-up.
Partnerships & IP: Secured an exclusive global license (ex-China) from Hengrui for HRS-1893/BHB-1893, with technology transfer milestones completed.
Commercial readiness: Building regulatory, manufacturing and future commercial capabilities, including plans for sales and marketing infrastructure and global trials.
Capital deployment: IPO proceeds are allocated to fund late-stage development and scale operations, with a projected cash runway into 2029.
